subject: SparkBridge customer spotlight — logo & quote rights
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@sparkbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SparkBridge customer spotlight — logo & quote rights

Hi Nora —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. We’re putting together a short customer spotlight (one-page case highlight + short quote) to feature SparkBridge on our site and in an upcoming partner email. We wanted to run the proposed scope by you and get written permission to use your logo, a 1-2 sentence quote from the marketing team, and a 300-word anonymized excerpt describing the integration benefits.

High-level asks:
- Permission to use SparkBridge logo (web & email) at the size shown in the draft.
- Approval to publish a 1–2 sentence quote attributed to "SparkBridge, Marketing" (we'll send the draft quote for review).
- Consent to include a small screenshot of the dashboard (product screenshot) — if you prefer we can omit this.

Drafts + brand assets: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2B3cDraftSpotlight/view (attached as sparkbridge_draft_spotlight_v1.docx)

If you’re okay with the scope, would you be able to confirm in writing or route to legal for a short consent PDF? We can accept a signed PDF or a confirmation email with any redlines/conditions.

Thanks — we’ll keep the quote language flexible and happy to incorporate any restrictions.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: (415) 555-0124
E: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: sparkbridge_draft_spotlight_v1.docx
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@sparkbridge.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@sparkbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkBridge customer spotlight — logo & quote rights

Hi Diego —

Thanks — this sounds great. I’ve looped in our legal lead Evan (cc). Two quick requests from marketing:
- Please do not include any customer-specific revenue/usage metrics in the public copy.
- If you include a product screenshot, we need to approve the exact image and mask any customer-identifying data.

Evan — can legal provide a short consent PDF for logo + quote usage, with a clause that SparkBridge must approve any press-release-level distribution? If you need a draft, Diego has attached the copy and art.

We can provide the brand guidelines if helpful (I’ll attach).

Best,
Nora Patel
VP, Marketing | SparkBridge
N: (212) 555-0198

Attachments: sparkbridge_brand_guidelines.pdf

Subject: Re: SparkBridge customer spotlight — logo & quote rights

Diego / Nora / Team —

Thanks for the background. We reviewed the draft and the brand guidelines. SparkBridge is happy to provide a limited marketing consent with the following conditions:

1) Rights granted: non-exclusive permission to use SparkBridge name, logo, and the specific 1–2 sentence quote provided by SparkBridge Marketing on Redwood Inference public website and email communications.
2) No product screenshots may be published without prior written approval of the image; screenshots can be provided for internal review but require separate sign-off.
3) No inclusion of customer-specific revenue or contract terms.
4) This consent is valid for 12 months from the date of signature; any press release or paid media placement requires an additional approval cycle.

Attached is the signed consent PDF (sparkbridge_marketing_consent_signed.pdf). Please confirm receipt and that you will adhere to the restrictions.

Regards,
Evan Cho
General Counsel | SparkBridge
E: evan.cho@sparkbridge.com
T: (212) 555-0177

Attachments: sparkbridge_marketing_consent_signed.pdf
